items.meta: Expected outline not covered: a heap for top-K

blocks.text: After the tap the card leaves the list and the count drops.

msgs.what: On probe, clarification, claim-check and edge-case cards. The other kinds show Done, which does the same thing.
The store drops the card and keeps its id in `usedIds` (last 100), so a resumed run re-sending the same card is ignored.
The text sent is the card's `probe`, else its first item, else its title: whatever the interviewer actually relayed.
Enqueues a `CopilotCardUsed` event. Errors are logged and swallowed; the interviewer is never blocked.
Appended once per card id, capped at 50, with the question id (falling back to the active one) and the time. It is state, so it survives a restart and reaches the report through `report_snapshot`.
